newsitem.title: UK: Biocompatibles up after Merrill buy note.
newsitem.headline: Biocompatibles up after Merrill buy note.

text.p: Shares in Biocompatibles International Plc forged ahead on Friday after Merrill Lynch issued a buy note on the British healthcare technology group, traders said.
The stock was up 160p at 11.00 stg by 1020 GMT.
"We have set an intermediate price target of 16 pounds per share," Merrill said in a report.
The broker said the profit outlook for the company had changed since it embarked on a joint venture with specialist cardeovasculate company Divysio in November.
Shares in Biocompatibles have risen nearly 18 percent this month after the company successfully issued 9.6 million new shares on January 7.
